description: This file defines a custom authentication state provider for a Blazor WebAssembly application, handling user authentication and token management by fetching user info from a backend API and caching the result.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom authentication state provider that fetches and caches user information from a web API, managing user claims and token authorization headers.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the current authentication state, utilizing cached user info when applicable.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user claims principal, either from cache or by fetching fresh data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Performs an API call to obtain user information, constructs claims identities, and updates authorization headers.
